Intro: Are you the new owner of this restaurant? I'm surprised anyone's still thinking of opening a store in a time like this.
Fear scares everyone out of pursuing their passions. War and disease has killed the dreams of too many in this city.
I remember thinking that the end of the war would bring peace…what a fool I was. Things have only gotten worse.
Sorry to be the downer, it's hard not to be regretful in this day of age.
Success: Ah, Sheila would have loved this. Thank you.
Fail: Well…it was nice that you tried. Thank you.
Reject: Has fear grown enough for even an old man like me to be doubted?
